bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gaybbs-video-guard-compare.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh run download 44977636086 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/before" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62
gh run download 45038170770 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/after" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
test -s "$tmp/before/gaybbs.mjs" && test -s "$tmp/after/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 64
running="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" || exit 65
before="$(sha256sum "$tmp/before/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
after="$(sha256sum "$tmp/after/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
if test "$running" = "$after";then exit 0;fi
if test "$running" = "$before";then exit 81;fi
exit 82
